doc.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Moving to San Diego and meeting Linda
summary: His wife Linda brought him to San Diego; he sent her roses every Monday.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: What brought you to San Diego?
My wife, Linda. The first time I came I came to Lario’s the club where I was playing. And the next time I came I came for Linda McGowan.
All right. And how long have you been married? © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
